notes: Registry spans are used because they explicitly report the exact served secondary endpoint. The served HR, CI, and counts match. The served ITT label remains unsupported. served_outcome.estimand specifies RR, whereas the source and served_row report HR; no risk ratio was inferred. Full-text methods confirm a double-blind, placebo-controlled randomized trial.
